$description: Card and Panel: their surface (Flat, the default; Glow; Inset) and elevation (Outline, the default; Halo; Lifted; Floating) (owner, 2026-10-15, the card builder). Every combination is allowed; the design system shows them all with the card builder.

card-surface-glow-image.$description: Glow: the card surface in the middle (to 55%), fading to the rim color at the edges.

card-surface-inset-shadow.$description: Inset: a 12px soft inner edge in the rim color.

card-elevation-border-color.$description: Halo, Lifted and Floating: no visible border (the 1px stays, transparent, so the card keeps its size).

card-elevation-lifted-shadow.$description: Lifted: a fuller even shadow (the shadow of menus that open).
